subject: newt
title: Scientists Removed This Animal's Eye Lens 18 Times

scenes.text: Scientists removed this animal's eye lens eighteen times. It grew back every time.
It's a newt. The experiment ran for sixteen years, starting in 1994.
Each time, the newt grew a brand new lens from the edge of its iris.
By the last round, the new lens was as clear and as fast-growing as the original.
No cataracts. The newts were at least thirty years old by the end.
Age slowed nothing down. Eighteen lenses, and the eye never gave out.

description:
Scientists removed this animal's eye lens eighteen times, and it grew back every time.
In a sixteen-year experiment, newts regrew lenses that matched the originals, with no cataracts.
What would you regrow first?
first_comment: Eighteen times, no cataracts. Which animal superpower would you borrow?
